_note: External commands exposed to a program as extra bindings. Load with `vsep ptc --extras <path>`.
Without the flag the built-in sixteen are the whole surface; this file is the only way anything
else gets in, because these commands run with your authority and naming them is a decision.
Each entry: name (identifier), command, args, optional acceptsPath / timeoutMs / description.
acceptsPath appends the program's `path` argument to the end of args, so put the tool's own flags
before it -- argparse accepts options ahead of a positional argument.
The paths below are placeholders. This example ships with the repository; the file you actually
use belongs outside it, so a checkout of two other projects is not baked into this one.

bindings.name: torikago_json
bindings.description: Static triage of one file, as Torikago's own JSON (never executes the target).

bindings.name: nanodesu_info
bindings.description: Summarise a PyInstaller archive, as Nanodesu's own JSON (never executes the target).

bindings.name: nanodesu_verify
bindings.description: Decompress every entry of an archive and check its lengths.
